links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy for MVI with versus without nomogram assistance
links.effect: Nomogram assistance improved radiologists' diagnostic accuracy for MVI by up to 13.4 percentage points.
links.quote: The nomogram's implementation enhanced radiologists' diagnostic accuracy for MVI by up to 13.4 percentage points.

links.outcome: Nomogram AUC across two external test sets from different centers
links.effect: AUCs of 0.853 (test set1) and 0.852 (test set2), consistent across both external sets and higher than the clinical model.
links.quote: The nomogram demonstrated numerically superior predictive performance in both external test sets, achieving AUCs of 0.853 (test set1) and 0.852 (test set2).

screen.reason: The study evaluates a machine learning radiomics nomogram and explicitly tests its impact on radiologist decision-making (evaluating radiologists' diagnostic performance with vs. without the tool).
